payload.title: Write the Gherkin feature specs
payload.description:
Write features/sentiment-meter.feature with step definitions under features/steps/ driving the library directly (no Plexus host): counting a thanks message; ignoring profanity in a code block; ignoring a pasted log; today with day-start 04:00 assigning a 03:59 message to yesterday; a rolling last-24h window; deduplicating a forked session; output containing counts only (privacy). Per The Way, behavior is specified before implementation code.

Done when: pnpm test:features runs the scenarios green; scenarios cover every window kind and the exclusion rules.
